name: classify ticket
description: Judge the ticket classifier exactly against known categories.

input.subject: Charged twice
input.body: My card was charged twice for the March invoice.

expected.description: The ticket is classified as billing.

input.subject: Downgrade my plan
input.body: How do I move from Pro to the Starter plan at renewal?

expected.description: The ticket is classified as billing.

input.subject: Export fails
input.body: Every CSV export ends with error 500 since this morning.

expected.description: The ticket is classified as technical.

input.subject: Webhook never arrives
input.body: Our Slack integration stopped receiving webhooks.

expected.description: The ticket is classified as technical.

input.subject: Locked out
input.body: I reset my password but still cannot sign in.

expected.description: The ticket is classified as account.

input.subject: Office hours
input.body: Are you open on public holidays?

expected.description: The ticket is classified as other.
